A struggling, no-name actress of seven years, Yu-Ra Hwang. She barely lands a minor role in a movie that’s bound to be a success. A celebrity’s celebrity, Seung-Hyeon Kang, keeps running into Yu-Ra, who always seems to be shedding tears every time he comes across her. As these two reunite in the new movie, “Time,” will Yu-Ra finally seize the moment to make her name known? And will Seung-Hyeon figure out why he can’t get Yu-Ra out of his mind? The story centers on 17-year-old high school student Shiori. She wants to end her feelings for her first love, so she decides to lay her body against a guy's just once. However, his heat and breath captivate her, and she can't seem to separate herself from him. They might become friends with benefits...

"This school is dangerous."

It is an uninhabitable land. It is a land where the dead cannot exit, where they gather.

In there, an independent high school is built. A place where the living and the dead intermingle, and it is where Eun-Bi, who is given the fate of a psychic, is admitted into.

Eun-Bi listens to the stories of the dead and solves cases whilst wandering the path of ghosts hidden in the school with Seon-Woo, whom she met by chance before entering the school.

"Ah, I forgot to tell you. This is a two-story building. If you ever see a staircase leading to the third floor, don't ever go up."

143009.description:
The outbreak of the Punishing virus destroyed almost all the achievements of human civilization as technological development touched forbidden areas. The survivors of the cruel environment still hold hope and are now determined to recover the Earth and rebuild human civilization.

The manga records the story of the characters in the game's worldview, who have influenced the course of history with their own powers. In addition, the past of the living weapon against the Punishing virus, the Constructs, are also included in the extra chapters.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

143010.description:
When Kotone, an ordinary office lady, ran into a shrine to get out of the rain, she found a hurt puppy and treated its injuries. Suddenly, the puppy transformed into a beautiful god who is not of this world! And then he proposed marriage to her and held the wedding that very night!

You've forgotten me, haven't you?
You'll be able to find out what's going on in the world of the gods.
A pure romance about love in the space between reality and fantasy.

(Source: Ohzora Shuppan, translated)

One night, I finally met a boy who seemed to be a “Yokai” that emits a faint light under the bridge. The boy, however, is a mixed blood of a monster and a human being—named “Hanyo”.

The comic anthology depicts the fun and exciting daily lives of the characters in Bofuri, including the members of the Maple Tree guild.

143014.description:
“Please, I implore you to save the world.”

This is what a goddess in white says to me in a pure-white space. Such is the standard line that suggests the game is about to begin. Please say this stirring line to boys and girls with sparkling eyes! It’s wrong to direct it to someone like me, who’s exhausted from job hunting! When I declined her politely, she flew into a fit of tears; when I agreed to assist her on small tasks out of reflex, she proclaimed: “It’ll be fine if you just help in the Starting-Village Arc. Please guide the Hero!” Then she tossed me into another world. No, this is a world modeled after a game that this gamer goddess likes…

(Source: Libre, translated)

After losing everything and running away, there is a free mahjong parlor in the crowds of Shinjuku.
I have 0 yen to my name, Still I chose to live.
This is a battlefield.
And in a battlefield… it's kill or be killed.

143024.description:
Mitsuki Namikawa has always been in love with 2D characters. However, her strict mother, just as consistently, disapproves of her daughter’s obsession, going so far as to banning anime and games in the house when Mitsuki was younger.
Her two best friends and coworkers, Atsuno and Madoka, accept her for all she is: a complete manga and anime addict. Atsuno shares Mitsuki’s love for anime and manga while Madoka tags along with their passionate preaching and enjoys having two close girl friends who support each other with no judgment.
One day, when the three friends go to Atsuno’s and have their regular anime watching drinking night, Mitsuki meets a character like she has never met before. Even though she knows he only exists beyond the screen, what lengths will Mitsuki go to for this 2D character?!

(Source: Manga Planet)

title.english: No Matter Where You Are, I Love You
title.romaji: Kimi ga Dokodemo Koi wa Koi

143025.description:
After 10 grueling years as a monster hunter in the Devil’s Army, Raven Balt was given his final mission: guard Allen Pendragon, heir of a formerly glorious dragon-taming family. But when Raven and Allen are both killed as part of a conspiracy, Raven wakes up seven years in the past inside Allen’s body. To solve the mystery behind his death, Raven must find the legendary White Dragon to restore the power of House Pendragon. But does this mere hunter have what it takes to become a dragon master?

(Source: Tapas)

143028.description:
Imaizumi lives a life that most high school boys could only dream of! During the day, he attends his classes like any dutiful student, only to return each evening to a home full of hotties! It seems his home has become the go-to hangout for the coolest gyarus in town. From endless gossip fests to snack binges to getting downright physical with his three new housemates, his once-quiet abode is now buzzing with non-stop energy and exciting escapades. Can Imaizumi keep up with the lively antics of his lusty gal pals?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

143029.description:
Erina, daughter of a duke, was raised to become the crown prince’s bride.
Alvis, royal by blood but serving as a member of the Royal Guard, never imagined life beyond duty.
But everything changes when Crown Prince Girard abruptly breaks off his engagement to Erina — and the king declares Alvis the new heir and Erina’s fiancé.
Once a guard, now a prince, Alvis struggles to adapt to his new role and responsibilities. Erina, now engaged to a stranger, must reconcile her duty with her desire for true love.
In a world ruled by status and expectation, can a love born of circumstance bloom into something real?

(Source: TOKYOPOP, edited)

143030.description:
A collection of romances unknown to the human species. "Tsutsuki and Shippo": A new squirrel friend comes to the zoo and Tsutsuki, a Japanese tit, is worried about his wellbeing. What can the little bird do to help the new kid out? "Beat and Nanada": Beat is a Rockhopper Penguin and Mr. Nanada is his caretaker. Will Beat be able to overcome the language barrier and tell Nanada how he really feels? "Ollie and Rankan": Rankan and Leo came to Hoshino Zoo from the wild. Rankan looked up to Leo and was always by his side... but he quickly learns that his place next to Leo was fleeting. So when Leo's son Ollie attaches himself to Rankan, all he can do is protect himself from being abandoned again. "Kurihara and Oka": Kurihara has been able to talk to animals since he was a child and has always seen them as human. But he would never dare tell any other human that for fear he might be bullied again. Recently, though, Kurihara isn't the only person that visits the zoo often. Who is that new boy clumsily trying to take pictures of everyone?

(Source: Futekiya)

143031.description:
The first step to winning the Love Game is saying “I love you.” So how do you lose? By admitting you’re in love!

Let the games begin! Since childhood, Yukiya Asagi and Miku Sakura have played the Love Game, where they try to fluster each other with a simple “I love you.” But after falling in love for real and refusing to admit it, neither of them can afford to lose this battle!

After leaving behind his image as a quiet nerd, Yukiya’s ready to break hearts and take names with the ultimate high school glow-up. Well, he’s really just got one girl in his sights - his best friend, Miku! Using her favorite shojo manga as his weapon, he’s ready to pin her to the wall and gaze at her with a perfect smolder. Will his moves get her heart racing?

(Source: VIZ Media)

This led to the invention of the Alternaphone, which allows people to freely reincarnate between worlds, allowing earthlings to become adventurers and otherworlders to become normal citizens. The series follows two amnesiac girls, earthling Kurami Utaho and otherworlder Melua Solaris, as they go back and forth between ordinary life on Earth and adventuring on Alterna.

143037.description:
In the 29th-century, Earth is no longer the center of humanity. Now robots are deployed to deal with the conflicts of the past. "Elcie", a humanoid robot from the moon, is one of those "Bouncers." She works, sings, and even feasts on meals! Far future action & relaxing SF.

(Source: Amazon Kindle, translated)

143038.description:
For three years, everyone in school criticized me for pursuing Zhao Guanyu. They said, “Aren’t you, a man, ashamed of pursuing another man so publicly that everyone knows about it?” However, what made Zhao Guanyu change his mind to pursue me a few years later? Is it love? Is it responsibility? Of course not. It's my face!

(Source: Bilibili Comics, edited)

This is an adventure story about the comic artist himself. A well-known comic artist, who often falls behind his schedule, got into his own work as a character because of a mysterious phone call. He is a bald-headed supporting character, called Ming. As an artist, how could he just be willing to be a supporting character! But can the creator really change his final destiny?

(Source: MangaToon)

143041.description:
In a post-apocalyptic world, Ye Fan'ou gained the power of the Super Takeout System. Twisted zombies? Mutant beasts? Anyone who wants to mess with his deliveries will have to get past his frying pan first!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

143043.description:
An accident caused Jiang Xue to forget all about Xia Zhi, the boy who changed her life so much. As they pursued their basketball dreams together, the secrets of the past will slowly be revealed...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

143044.description:
Just like always, I made dinner and waited for my husband to come home. But when he came back, he kept ignoring me. He acted as if I wasn't there. What's more, after he finished dinner, he started checking his phone with a beaming face I had never seen before. It seemed like he was secretly texting with a girl. And that girl was none other than my younger sister... "Why did it have to be my sister...? She always takes away everything from me..."

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes 4 extra stories.

143048.description:
Jiang Qiu was trying to climb over a school wall to skip class when he fell and killed himself! A moment later he awakes and finds that he has transmigrated into the Daxu Dynasty as a young master of the Jiang family. His biological mother passed away when he was young while his stepmother and brother do whatever they please in the house. In order to escape his stepmother and brother's evil schemes, and to prove his own worth, he decides to work hard and forge his own path toward the peak of life. One day, he will become a winner of life itself...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: Our Young Master's Plans Are Infallible

143050.description:
“These three could destroy the country all by themselves if they wanted… But there was one thing they just couldn't get.”

For the three strongest adventurers in the world, finding a man strong enough to be with them is a herculean task. He simply doesn’t exist. With that in mind, they decide to take on a perfect novice—the level-zero, unremarkable Cross Alacart—and train him up to be their perfect match. Freshly expelled from Adventurers’ school, Cross sets his eyes on redemption; training hard and learning to believe in himself along the way.

(Source: Comikey)

A mysterious girl, Alice, falls from the sky. Brace yourselves because this is not the tale of Alice we all know.

A former actress is determined to do anything to get back to the top, even if means going underground to the world of porn.

143055.description:
A few friends head to an island for beach relaxation and fun. But when night falls they realize that their boat has mysteriously disappeared. Can these sheltered bums survive on their own? A tale of mystery, violence, sex, and the true nature of humans.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

143056.description:
Humans call them “calamities”—the unknown, destructive creatures that suddenly appeared on earth. To challenge these calamities, the zodiac gods awakened 12 humans known as saints. But there was one more that awoke—unchosen but the greatest hero of all: Geon Lee. His allies betrayed him and left him for dead, but now, 20 years later, he’s more powerful than ever and ready to teach his fellow “saints” a lesson they’ll never forget.

(Source: Tapas)

5-8. Takabisha Elf Kyousei●Konin!! (高飛車エルフ強●婚姻！！)
9. Reizoku Maou: Epilogue (隷属魔王 Epilogue)

143059.description:
After a car crash mysteriously transports him to a land of martial arts, Cha Shinhyun trains for 140 years and becomes the strongest being in Murim. But when he returns to Earth, it’s nothing like he remembers. Though he is finally reunited with his sister, the home he once knew is now filled with people called “hunters'' who defeat monsters to level up their powers in a constant race for survival. Now he must start back at level 1 and work to exact revenge on the person who altered his fate!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: カンストからのレベルアップ

143061.description:
True-to-life depictions of the patterns and fashions of the romances of young women.

(Source: Torigura, translated)

143062.description:
Hyun-Woo is a struggling part-timer who can barely make ends meet, let alone prepare for a proper job. The only thing he excels in is online games, which contributes nothing when it comes to his search at finding a cushy job at a big-name company. One day, he learns that “Global Exus,” one of the biggest gaming companies, is using their newly developed virtual reality game, "New World," to recruit new hires. With an empty bank account, an absent father, and a sick mother to care for, the game seems like Hyun-Woo’s only chance to turn his life around. Gone are the days of living paycheck-to-paycheck as a failed athlete, in this “New World,” Hyun-Woo becomes the warrior “Ark.” Will he be able to find his way to outrank the others and secure the job of his dreams?

(Source: Lezhin US)

143063.description:
The first time Vedis transmigrated into the novel “Princess of Eventide,” she followed the original plot exactly for seven straight years—and lost almost everyone she loved along the way. Lucky for her, she’s been sent back to the start again along with her close friend Rosanne, the princess of Moselberg. Together, they will do everything in their power to prevent the violent rebellion and save the people they love. But when they start making different choices, what else will change? And will they discover the traitors in time?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Second Life on the Red Carpet

143069.description:
One day, the most beautiful girl in school suddenly shows up at Kento Ikuno's door. She shows him a "ticket" written in awkward handwriting. This is the start of a romantic comedy about a "ticket to do anything I say" that came from his childhood.

(Source: Tonari no Young Jump, translated)

title.native: 聞いてくれますよね？先輩

143071.description:
We all have embarrassing memories or deep regrets from high school, right? Socially anxious college senior Natsuki Haibara sure does. When he thinks back on that time of his life, all he has are fleeting fantasies of a happy adolescence that could have been. Imagine his bewilderment and surprise, then, when he inexplicably finds himself seven years in the past—one month before his first year of high school! Can Haibara avoid his previous mistakes, make his way to the top of the school social pyramid, and end up with the girl of his dreams? Or will he be forced to relive three years of solitude as the most hated guy in school? He’ll need all the help he can get in order to succeed, from a workout regimen to online how-to guides, a childhood friend, and plenty of sheer willpower. Watch as Haibara takes a second shot at his teenage years!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.native: 灰原くんの強くて青春ニューゲーム
title.romaji: Haibara-kun no Tsuyokute Seishun New Game

143072.description:
Rinko Minami, the daughter of the company president, was set up for a possible arranged marriage with a promising talent in the company. She felt like she couldn't get married after finally forgetting her terrible ex-boyfriend, but then she met the handsome, elite guy, Masato Takayanagi, who was very popular with the women at work. Thinking that this misogynistic man will fail in an arranged marriage, she accepted his proposal, but for some reason, they ended up contractually marrying.......? A man-hating woman and a woman-hating man start their temporary married life! This work is a manga adaptation of a popular web-novel, "A Marriage Not So Sweet".

(Source: Mecha Comic, translated)

title.native: 義妹は浮気に含まれないよ、お兄ちゃん

143076.description:
I've had a crush on Yuki-kun since junior high school, but I've been unable to tell him how I feel about him.
It's because I have a secret that I can't tell Yuki-kun, even more than this love...

(Source: Betsucomi, translated)

143077.description: A boy wants to confess his love to his senpai, but his plans are ruined when he turns into a girl. The twist is when she finds out that he's a girl, and she tells him she used to be a boy too, and promises to show him the ropes of girlhood.

synonyms: The person I like is a bit... y’know, and I’m having trouble hiding my surprise

143079.description:
“When you get to know the real me… you will be disappointed.”

Chinatsu, a hitman, meets his destiny again. His name is Kasumi. He was the boy who reached out to Chinatsu when he lost his brother in front of his eyes.

A few years later, Chinatsu rescues Kasumi from a snatcher by chance. Kasumi is blind, and Chinatsu can’t leave him alone in the street… although he knows he shouldn’t get close to him, the distance between them gets shorter day by day…

A story of redemption, in which two young men trapped in darkness slowly soothe each other’s loneliness.

(Source: ShuCream BL)

143092.description:
Unable to bear their debt-laden father's selfish behavior, Asagi and his sister ran away from home. At a loss for what to do, they were helped by Kaname, a rich heir they happened to meet at a cafe.

"Would you like to make a contract with me?" It was a deal they couldn't refuse, a strange cohabitation life is about to begin.

A twisted love story between a devious rich heir and a poor boy trying to protect his sister.

(Source: Comic Fleur, translated)

143093.description:
Kei had been pining for his childhood friend Kuro, who was a year younger than him. Other people teased him that they are like owner and dog.
Tired of spending all his time with Kuro, Kei was about to join a drinking party to try to find a girlfriend, when Kuro confessed love for him!
This is a love story about the hidden obsessions of the younger childhood friend.

143095.description:
The story centers on a doctor and a girl named Toki, who climb steep mountains and cross barren wastes on their journey together. Even though the doctor can ride on clouds and soar through the sky, the doctor does not lend a helping hand to Toki, only going on ahead of her and stopping somewhere to drink and eat while waiting for her. They have a puzzling way of traveling that nevertheless remains intimate.

(Source: Anime News Network)

143096.description:
A mopey gangster who's as loyal as he is violent and a top-dog delinquent who's a glutton for pleasure! These testosterone-filled teenagers are up to no good, in more ways than one!

Wimpy crybaby Taichi goes to a school full of delinquents, but for some reason, all the bad kids in school think he's their leader! There's a secret only Taichi doesn't know... the fact that he has an alter-ego who's a ruthless delinquent! And, little does Taichi know, he sometimes regresses to a child-like state. He doesn't even know what touching himself is, despite his body being in the throes of puberty...

Mitsuru Gunji, leader of a rival school's gang, takes interest in Taichi and starts initiating him into the ways of pleasure. After melting in Mitsuru's arms after his first time (mentally speaking), Taichi starts begging for more!

(Source: Renta!)

143097.description:
33 years have passed since the world filled with zombies. However, a boy named Lee Ji-Seung, whose blood can heal zombies, appears. For this, he is worshiped as a guardian angel to his people. Ji-Seung, who admires the Zero era (when there were no zombies), is strangely attracted when he is near a man who has just been awakened from his dream and who goes by the name of Jeon Ho-Gyeong.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

143098.description: Two girls were taking the same train in the morning, without really interacting with each other. Until one day, where one of them asks: "Can I sleep on your shoulder?"

143099.description:
Infamous jailbreaker Rosen Walker is finally being transferred to the Isle of Monte, the most notorious maximum security prison in the world. Her guard? It’s none other than the beloved war hero of the empire himself — Ian Connor. Now Ian must unravel the truth. Did Rosen really commit the murder? Or is there more to the story?

(Source: Manta)

143101.description:
The powerful ruler of all demons, the Demon King, gets punished by God after rebelling against him. As a result, he loses his precious demon horn. To get it back, he must find the 'Princess of Hell' and together, they must purify 100 evil spirits that lurk in the human world. But can the Demon King betray his demon followers and successfully purify them? And it seems there's another issue at hand... "Why is the Demon King so obsessed with his horn?" That's because, without it, he keeps losing his memories!

(Source: Copin Comics)

143102.description:
"What?! You bought an Elf?!"

A wealthy lord buys an Elf to be used as his sex slave, however, he had no idea how dangerous it could be... Will he ever be able to satisfy this perverted Elf?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

2. Jiguzagu-sen (ジグザグ線)
3. Suiheisen (水平線)
4. Start Line (スタートライン)

(Source: Fanza)

143105.description:
What is it like to be seduced by the disciple you raised with your own hands? The Chaos Master of the Immortal and Demonic Worlds accidentally took in the king of the qilin tribe as his disciple, and now his favored disciple is treating him like his own true love? But he has the duty to save heaven and earth, much too busy to fall in love!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

143106.description: Two childhood friends enjoy sparring over a fighting game on the day their lives would be irrevocably changed.

143107.description:
This is the story of a male elf who has his legs amputated and is transformed into a hermaphrodite so that he can be raped and impregnated.

(Source: Booth, translated)

143108.description:
As a fan of idol Ryu Seon-Jae, Im Sol was happy fangirling to her heart’s content. That is until one day, Seon-Jae is suddenly found dead. As she grieves, Sol discovers a curious pocket watch that takes her six years into the past. Before she knows it, Sol tracks down a teenage Seon-Jae, and the words “I freaking love you!” spill out. Now, he’s totally creeped out by her, but Sol must somehow win over Seon-Jae to stop history from repeating. With the clock ticking, can she save her future number one?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

143110.description:
Sae is a college student who, for his own reasons, likes to wear bras. One day at the laundromat, he meets a mysterious man.
At first, Sae has his guard up with the man, who seems to know a little too much about bras, but after a while, Sae learns that Akihiro Togyoku is a designer for Sunline, a brand of men's bras.
The two have started getting close when Akihiro tells Sae he knows a special way to desensitize Sae's "pink little things"...!!

143111.description:
Motoya's been crushing hard on Haruma for the longest time - he's just so cute and adorable, and touching his soft, supple skin is always the highlight of his day. If only they weren't just masseuse and client - if only this weren't just for work! Motoya knows he should really get his act together and make a move on Haruma already, but when he sees Haruma hand-in-hand with an older man, has he already lost his chance?

(Source: Futekiya)

143112.description:
After going through a string of unfortunate events in his past, Ryousuke signs up for a gym membership in the hopes of making himself stronger. But when he meets personal trainer Souji and his beautiful hands, suddenly "getting stronger" isn't so high up on his list of priorities anymore! Is there a chance for them to ever get closer than just trainer and client? Meanwhile, there appears to be a dangerous serial assaulter on the loose...

(Source: Futekiya)

143113.description: Domoto Shigeru studied painting when he was in Sapporo. Deeply grieved that a woman succumbed to the charm of his colleague, Shigeru began to paint and decided to enter the world of painting.

143114.description:
When daydreaming part-timer Chihiro gets forced to order from a random maid cafe for a punishment game, he's expecting sweet, delicate maids to cater to his every whim... so why is this tall, buff dude wearing a frilly maid outfit and calling him "Master"? Mako may not look like the ideal pretty maid, but Chihiro's about to find out what happens when you judge a maid by their muscles!

(Source: Futekiya)

title.english: I'll Make You My Number One Idol!

title.romaji: Ore no Saioshi wo Kimi ni Sasagu!

143115.description:
Upon her mother’s death, Jericho Hansen learns a shocking secret. Her late father, a man she never knew, was none other than the legendary dragon slayer Ezra Mibare. Not only that, but she has inherited his Dragon Slayer Sword, a fearsomely powerful blade that also talks… a lot. But when the Dragon Slayer lets it slip that her father may have produced a secret son, Jericho becomes determined to find her long-lost brother, and the journey to discover this mighty weapon’s true heir begins!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ปฏิบัติการตามหาลูกชายคุณพ่อ

title.english: Heir to the Dragon Slayer Sword

143116.description:
Who knew that the life of an aristocrat would be full of such loneliness? Ruri wakes up one day as Albertina von Rozenburg, the oldest legitimate child of the Rozenburg family. This new life of hers is full of tetchy servants, unfamiliar rules, and distant family members. Ruri longs to go back to her familiar world, but there’s no one here to guide her. With no one to trust, Ruri becomes wary of everyone, even the only person who seems to care about Albertina: Elma, a young servant girl who follows Albertina with a dogged devotion. When Ruri finds out that Albertina’s only purpose is to get married off to an unpleasant, albeit very handsome, prince, she’s had enough. She’s going to find a way out of here, even if that means she doesn’t act according to the traditions of this world, so be it.

(Source: Lezhin US)

143117.description:
After being put on trial, the deity once known as "The Divine Twilight" is offered a job by Thanatos, king of the underworld! Now, the fallen deity is back on Earth as his former self, Lee Chang-Seon, and is tasked with sealing those trying to invade from beyond. With the promise of a fresh start, Chang-Seon is gathering the gear and skills needed to get the job done, but he's feeling some watchful eyes on him... Will this Divine Twilight see a new day, or is the sun setting on his second chance?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

143119.description:
Mr. Murata, a high school teacher, has always been good at everything he does. But now he has a problem. He is being bullied by his student, erotically. She is Tamura, the center of the class. She uses every possible means to threaten him, shake him, catch him, gather evidence, and then threaten him again. The other day, she took a picture of him in a compromising position. And today, in the infirmary, Tamura said, "Strip naked and get down on the floor, won't you?" Then she pulls out a small pink toy. "Can you open up your asshole and show me?" The problem is, there's a part of him that doesn't mind, that can't resist the immoral sensuality…

(Source: Kuro Mitou, translated)

143120.description:
In his previous life, Xia Lin dedicated his whole life to Song Yan, yet he still can’t escape the fate of being Song Yan’s second option. After being reborn, Xia Lin has decided to cut off their twisted relationship and stay away from Song Yan…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

143121.description:
In ancient times, a peaceful island was disturbed by the landing of foreigners from a more advanced civilization. The two groups seemed to coexist peacefully, and gave the chance for the young sculptor Palos and the beautiful Rota to meet and establish a tender relationship. But the ambitions of the court soothsayer and the arrival of a mysterious comet will turn the situation upside down.

(Source: Associazione Culturale Leiji Matsumoto, translated)

143122.description:
A once-popular idol’s career went downhill and ended up being the “canary” of a mysterious gang leader. What’s out of his expectation, this gang leader is his “stalking fan”. Let’s see how this has-been goes back to the top with the help of his powerful fan!

(Source: Copin Comics)

143123.description:
The 25 years old Tong Hua is once again harrassed by her parents to go to a marriage interview, and this time the guy supposedly is a noble? Little does she know, this man dressed in rags during their first meeting is not who he seems to be at all...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

143125.description: When trying to do his work correctly as a demon while the others are idling away in the demon world, Alfas goes to the human world and discovers a strong soul that seems delicious. But what will happen when the human he thought would beg for his life asks to have sex with him as his last wish ? And what is this pleasure he's feeling!?

"Arisugawa is a junior who is always teasing me. I'm definitely going to teach her a lesson..."

A senior x junior romantic comedy!

Walking in on your girlfriend cheating on you is tough. But when the cute girl next door offers to be your girlfriend for 3 weeks? And finish off all 17 fantasies on your bucket list? Well alright then. Maybe things aren't as bad as they seem.

143128.description:
After 3 years together, this couple has decided that they can't progress unless something changes. To improve their sex, they take the advice of some old friends and decide to make a list of their deepest, darkest sexual fantasies...

Sakurai Izumi visits a massage shop in hopes of rekindling her husband's affection. Little does she expect to encounter Tachikawa, the salon owner, leading to an unexpected and sensual connection. Will this massage offer her a new form of satisfaction?

My husband can't turn me on... So when my brother-in-law gives me a deep massage, I relax and then... I'm already cumming...!!?

143134.description:
A warm comedy spinoff series from Ace of the Diamond (aka Daiya no A) written by Yuki Okada, the wife of Yuji Terajima himself.

Sawamura and his fellow residents of room 5... accidentally adopted a cat? What will they do about meals? How will they bathe him? Worst of all, pets are prohibited from being kept in the dorms. Sawamura and his roommates struggle to overcome these challenges while keeping their new feline friend a secret. Still, they persevere, because who can resist the cuteness of cats?

Read Daiya no C to follow the adventures of the Seidou team and their new furry addition.

143135.description:
Rei finds himself teaching at a school for demi-humans who want to become full-fledged human beings! Can someone who dislikes humans teach others about humankind?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: A Misanthrope Teaches a Class for Demi-Humans
title.native: 人外教室の人間嫌い教師
人類存亡コクピットガールズ

143137.description:
Renowned for its exclusivity, only the children of Korea’s elite can attend International Island High. But when Kang Do-Ha, an ordinary girl from an average family, is given a lucky chance to enroll, she’s thrust into an unfamiliar world of money and power. Despite trying to fly under the radar, she somehow ends up in the same dorm as Rowoon, the most popular guy in school! He seems to have it all, but when it comes to girls, he’s completely clueless. Can Do-Ha teach him how to win a girl’s heart?

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: モテる男には秘密がある

143138.description:
The Thunder Kingdom in the Elemental Continent has long become legendary. The heir of the Thunder Kingdom will only appear when every elemental kingdom is in turmoil and distress. Due to the instability of the interface, whenever a huge earthquake erupts, all kinds of animals that evolve into monsters will appear in the Elemental Continent, putting humans in danger. Rumor has it that the world is about to end, and everyone is looking for a solution. Can the heir of the Thunder Kingdom, Lei Zhen, lead everyone to save the world?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

143139.description:
The high school girl Tsumugu was knocked unconscious during an earthquake, and when she woke up she found herself in Ginza in the year of Taisho 10 (1921). Lost and confused, she was rescued by Itsuki, a duke's daughter, and started attending a girls' school with her. What will happen to the future of a girl who has drifted to the distant past...?

(Source: Seiga Nicovideo, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes three bonus chapters.
synonyms: A Drift Girl And A Noble Moon

title.romaji: Tsumugu Otome to Taishou no Tsuki

143140.description:
The Cleaner will take on any job he is paid to do. A high school girl on the run became his unwanted assistant. The kidnapping of a rich heir! The traffic accident death of a genius artist! An exciting crime story about the famous (or infamous?) duo solving each case!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)

143141.description:
The mysterious witch doctor of the East reemerges!

A masterful witch doctor, Sun Dawei, comes down from the mountains to adopt a new life in the modern world. He has no ambitions, but just wants his family to live a healthy and happy life and for himself to make a living out of treating patients. Troubles, however, keep coming his way. Let's see how this "wolf in sheep's skin", through all the temptations and hardships, makes witch medicine great again.

Beautifully-drawn series with a feel-good story about a gigantic loser's counterattack!

(Source: INKR)

143142.description:
“To me, you may not tell even a word of lie.”

Year five of the unified Chang Empire, San the emperor, who brought peace to the chaotic world, returns to Changchunsung, his home, in disguise. There he runs into Kang, a demigod cast out from heaven and living as a human, and senses a strong attraction. Kang tries to distance himself from San as in Chang, relationships between humans and demigods are forbidden, and he would be executed once his demigod identity was revealed. Unable to disobey the orders of the emperor, Kang decides instead to deceive San. What does San know, and what has Kang forgotten? Bound by a tremendous fate neither can refuse, their lives intertwine yet again.

(Source: NETCOMICS)

title.native: 楽園殺し　～鏡の中の少女～

143144.description:
Yu-Jun and Kang-Ha are two boys that meet at a studio by chance. A wound in Yu-Jun's hand entices a strange attraction from Kang-Ha, and a strange love story begins.

Two boys explore their feelings for each other as their hands intertwine in more ways than one.

(Source: INKR, edited)

143146.description:
Ho-Su, who used to move a lot because of his parents work, finds a strange door in their new house. And he meets Seung-U, a boy of the same age who lives across the door.

The two boys, who shared a mysterious experience, began to come and go through the door. Warm air permeates between the two like a late afternoon. And slowly another secret grows in the hearts of the boys....

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

143147.description:
For five years, she's been eating at the same restaurant, but she doesn't feel comfortable saying anything to the restaurant owner, who wants to talk to that regular customer but doesn't know what to say. Their feelings are obvious, but they just can't find a way to express their love for each other yet.

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

Note: Originally self-published on Twitter, it was picked up for commercial publication on December 10, 2021.
synonyms: お互い言いたいことが言えない店員とお客さんの漫画
Otagai Itai koto ga Ienai Tenin to Okyaku-san no Manga

143148.description: Atsushi, a fourth-grade elementary school student, is a daydreaming and absent-minded boy who often dozes off. One day, during a math class while searching for a ruler, he is astonished to find that his hand has transformed into a ruler. From that moment on, he realizes that he can transform into anything he envisions in his mind. Together with his friend Yoshi,, whom he confides in, they discover a strange beetle and a family tree hidden in Atsushi's house, leading Atsushi to learn that he is a descendant of aliens.

143149.description: Kazanami is in love with Shino, a girl who sits next to him in class. She's extremely cute, but she's also extremely strong, and isn't good at controlling her power. With even the smallest actions causing massive destruction, how will Kazanami even survive, let alone get closer to her?

143151.description:
After a big fight with his family, Xia Ke heard a song whose gentle melody comforted his frustrated soul. So he became a devoted follower of that music streamer. And then suddenly the streamer became his classmate! "I want to be friends with him!" Now in addition to the college entrance exam, Xia Ke's life as a senior has one more goal. The daily school life of a small-time musician and his little fanboy.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Ta De Chulian Duixiang Shi Wo

143152.description:
Li Yue, who is determined to retain control on Chaoyue Corporation, and Jiang Yuqi, who is determined to use Chaoyue Corporation as his stepping stone in returning to Pudao. The two have irreconcilable conflicts with each other as they use each other and try to oppress the other, which resulted in them developing feelings for each other. In the end, they once again support each other to get through difficulties as one to successfully retain Chaoyue Corporation.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Pei Shang Wo, Zhuan Le Ta

143158.description:
“To be so drawn to a demon… What a strange onmyoji you are.”

Kon, an onmyoji living in Kyoto, is fascinated by the supernatural and the spirit world, to the extent that he struggles to fit in with his human peers. Then one day, he takes a job repairing magical barriers and makes his way to a yokai-exclusive red-light district. There, he comes across Ibaraki, a gorgeous four-horned demon—and former sex worker! Could this be the beginning of an unlikely romance between yokai and yokai-lover?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Love at the City’s Edge on a Moonlit Night

143159.description:
Erotic manga author Kudou's friend Haruki passes away, leaving behind his young daughter Kiki and a note bequeathing her to Kudou. Strange as the situation is, Kudou commits to making a real family for the girl—so when he meets a woman who reminds him of his late friend, he fires off a marriage proposal on the spot! By blood, friendship, love, or circumstance, family is family...

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: おとなのずかん改訂版

143160.description:
"I want to thrust everything I have...into you!"
The thought running through my head as the person I hate devours and stimulates my body beyond its limits. The sweet sensation never stops...!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: あなたじゃないと、イケない運命～ご無沙汰Ω、大嫌いなαと番ってました
title.romaji: Anata ja Nai to, Ikenai Unmei: Gobusata Omega, Daikirai na Alpha to Banttemashita

143161.description: Ginza 7-Chome is the most famous high-class neon district in Japan, where hundreds of thousands of restaurants and bars are competing with each other. Every night, many bargains between men and women are played out in ......, and often something is left in their wake. Trouble with rights, unpaid bills ......, there is a man you can rely on in such cases. Ginza's trouble-solver, or as he's called, "Zenjiro the Cutter"!

143162.description:
A holy sword to vanquish evil! A tale of a holy knight of love and courage! A realistic heroic fantasy created by a duo of truly talented creators! Long after the age of the gods, war rages. A graceful young lady named Freya stands up to resist the invasion of a mad emperor... for she is a descendant in the line of a legendary warrior! Long ago, during the age of the gods, the evil god Loki tried to cover the world in darkness. The overgod Odin gave a single warrior a holy sword and commanded him to vanquish Loki. Bravely, the warrior battled Loki by himself and defeated him with the help of the holy sword. But before he died, Loki left some creepy last words behind. "After thousands of years, I will be reborn!"

(Source: Group Zero)

title.native: フレイア戦記 ~剣の乙女~

143163.description: A boy and girl bond over bonsai.

143164.description:
Deployed to the Pacific Ocean during World War II, the destroyer Kofu was always on the front lines. Directly below the bridge, there were men who didn't handle weapons nor participate in the fighting. Instead, their job was to cook meals for their fellow sailors, as the "Cooking Officers." This is the story of the men who supported the war effort with their ultimate gourmet adventure!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Since times of old, it has always been the law of natural order for subjects to obey the emperor. However, this time, not only does a powerful general defy the emperor by climbing up the royal emperor’s bed but also demands that the emperor bears his children!

143528.description:
This is a story about a boy who always fails in love. The boy wants to fall in love, and there is a girl who likes him, but he fails again and again on the road to love, and he goes further and further astray. He really just wants to fall in love! Why does it always fail?

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

143529.description:
Shao Mengzhu, the "brainless" young leader of the League, was trying to convince the "unhappy" demon lord Si Kongnan to reform and repent his sins. But not only did he fail to convince the enemy to surrender, he was captured and forced to become the demon lord's queen (huh)? An epic tale of tragic brotherly love that will truly bring the reader to tears...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

When his cheerful and optimistic younger brother passes away suddenly, Mu Siyang infiltrates his school to investigate the cause of his brother's death.

Shocking things come to light: his roommate was a friend with benefits; his rumored boyfriend wanted to kill him; all the customers at his part time job wanted him... What did my brother go through before he died?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

143532.description:
Motoki is the student council president known to be hard on alphas. He hates how most of society still decides superiority based on dynamics despite modern times. Being an omega himself, Motoki refuses to let his dynamic define him. To him, alphas are scum who can't control their urges and instincts. However, there was an exception: his childhood friend Gou, who is unlike other alphas. When Motoki's suppressants go missing in his time of heat, he finds himself helpless against malicious alphas and is saved by Gou. But it seems that even Gou isn't immune to the instincts of his dynamic. Will this be the end of their friendship?

(Source: futekiya)

143535.description: A wedding planner is just counting the days until her wedding, but she's just not feeling it. One night, she catches one of her clients, a bride to be, in a compromising and morally-compromising situation. And yet... there's just something alluring about this woman that catches her off guard.

143536.description: Serialized as Sono Tobira no Mukougawa (その扉の向こう側) in Comic Mugen Tensei (2017-01, 04, 07, 10, 2018-01, 05).

143537.description:
It doesn't matter if your appearance or your gender has changed. I love you, because you're you.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

143538.description:
It's a story about psychological disorder. Twelve years ago, Lin Mo's mother, who was diagnosed of depression, wanted to kill herself and Lin Mo. Tai Yingjun, showing up like sunshine in Lin Mo's life, saved him. Twelve years later, after doing the Psychopathy Checklist-revised (PCL-R), Lin Mo was diagnosed of mental disorder. Will Lin Mo be saved by Tai Yingjun again?

(Source: Webnovel)

143539.description:
Lin Ruiyi has received a tough mission, that is to disguise as his twin sister and trick the most powerful president in the city, Shang Mingze. However, unlike his badass sister, Lin Ruiyi is way too introverted. At the banquet, he fell into Sheng Mingze's arm but he ran away like Cinderella instead of hoaxing this arrogant man. Just when he thought this whole thing was over, he met Sheng Mingze right the next day! It turns out he is Lin Ruiyi's new boss! Lin Ruiyi prays everyday that the president won't recognize him but ... it seems that he's already become Sheng's target...

(Source: MangaToon)

143541.description:
The police who don't want to be criminal investigators are not good movie stars -- the workaholic police officer Zhang Jiaming’s hope of being promoted as a criminal police was dashed when he offended Gu Nuo, a privileged young man from a rich family. He resigned in a fit of anger.

After losing his job, Zhang Jiaming happened to become an actor and fell in love with the industry. However, his career didn’t take off and he had to keep playing nobodies in different films. Once again, he ran in to Gu Nuo, who had already become a popular idol after being released from prison. What kind of sparks would they get when they meet each other on the narrow road again?

(Source: WeComics)

title.native: 先制テンプテーション
魔王があらわれた！俺の部屋に…
title.romaji: Maou ga Arawareta! Ore no Heya ni...

143546.description: Net is a young man whose true skill lies in his large personal connections, which has allowed him to achieve great feats from behind the scenes. One day, however, his own king runs out of patience with him, and banishes him from the legendary heroes' party. Now he has to start again as an adventurer, though he plans to make full use of his connections with powerful knightly orders and other races.
synonyms: A Heroic Legend Where Everyone Else Does the Work and Starts With a Social Relations Cheat

title.native: 人脈チートで始める人任せ英雄譚
title.romaji: Jinmyaku Cheat de Hajimeru Hitomakase Eiyuu-tan

143547.description:
Ling Feibai, the current blademaster, was as noble as an immortal. Kong Xiaomeng, an evil cult's religious fraudster, was as destitute as a dog. The two of them would have never crossed paths until one day, Kong Xiaomeng unexpectedly took in a handsome, elegant man. Not only was the man docile and obedient towards him, but his fighting skills were out of this world. The only thing was... he was a huge idiot that just stayed at home lazing around, even...

Kong Xiaomeng: Hey, hey, what are you doing?!
Ling Feibai: Master, you don't spoil me! Me, who's so weak, pitiful, and helpless!
Kong Xiaomeng: What do I do if I picked up a blademaster?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Jian Dao Jian Sheng Zhong Me Ban

143550.description:
As teenagers, Kuroga Akane and Shirosaki Aoi couldn’t have been more different. An alpha and an omega from rival schools, their initial meeting wasn’t exactly love at first sight. In fact, it was downright brutal! Fast forward to adulthood, and not only are they mated and married, but they even have an adorable daughter! How did these former delinquents go from wanting to beat each other to a pulp to falling in love?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: La historia de los padres de Shima

synonyms: So My Little Sister Brought Her Boyfriend Home

143556.description:
Su-Gyeom, an ordinary student on vacation, is surprised by his best friend Beom Jin-Hyeong coming out to him. But to be a good and reliable friend, he somehow winds up accompanying his friend to a gay bar. Somehow, he starts wondering about his own sexuality, and their relationship begins flowing in a strange direction...

The touching relationship between childhood friends Beom Jin-Hyeong and Han Su-Gyeom does not end with one verse.

Is friendship first? Does love come first?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

143557.description:
Ji-U, a rising star who is quickly drawing attention not only in Korea but also from top Hallyu star, Yoo-Han, is cast in the same film as him and meets Yoo-Han with a fluttering heart. But Ji-U is confused by the double-faced appearance of the good-natured and well-mannered Yoo-Han...

(Source: Manyeo Comics, translated)

143558.description:
Today's high school's entrance ceremony!

Even after middle school, 'Da-Joon' is still popular. But 'Si-Yoon' feels a strange sense of incompatibility with him...

One day, when Si-Yoon happens to go to Da-Joon's place, what he sees is... his violent side?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

143559.description:
Jeong Hyun is a policeman and a boyfriend to someone who thinks he looks good in erotic costumes. Burdened by his lover’s constant request for roleplay, Hyun plans to ask Do-Yoon for a normal relationship. But Do-Yoon’s answer is… “Can’t you wear this just once?”

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

143561.description:
I won't actually fall for him!

As 34-year-old divorcé Sungyoon contemplates dating again, he runs into an old college friend, Hyunsoo, who's now a famous writer. When he learns that Hyunsoo's in a slump, Sungyoon offers to help... only to be taken aback when Hyunsoo suggests they be contract lovers to spice up his romance novel!

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: エンディングのための契約恋愛

143563.description:
An arrogant little shota (young boy) is coerced into some lovey-dovey sex by a dull university student.
The pay's good by the boy I have to teach is a total brat...
It's about time he got some downright (sexual) discipline!

title.romaji: Katekyo-chuu, Namaiki na Shota wo Oshioki Shita Kekka Ero Kawaii Ken ww

Chana-kun is a sun-kissed foreign exchange student.
While the protagonist is playing at his house, a man comes home.
The man and Chana-kun start having sex in front of him.

The Tan Boy, the Old Man and Me.

143567.description:
A couple that has been together for 3 years, but dated for fewer than 100 days... And, because of the playing-hard-to-get Jae-Hwa, Do-Hyeong is making a fuss. Do-Hyeong wants to do something about it, but because of the naive Jae-Hwa, he gets really upset. However, the highschooler who lives on the first floor is weird. Their story is all about being foolish and clumsy in front of love.

(Source: Jin Comics)

143568.description:
I gave a guy I hate a love potion?

Hong-Yu, after quarreling with top star Ji Seol-U due to a wretched first meeting, gave Seol-U a love potion. That shady love potion…did he really drink it?!

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

143569.description:
Her late parent's death made her feel lonely. She couldn't trust anyone, particularly when she can hear their true thoughts, so she always felt lonely. This was true, until she visited the aquarium.

"It was the first time since I was born that I heard someone's voice and thought it was beautiful."
"Can I listen to you one more time?"

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

143570.description:
Yuichi Miura's wife suddenly asked for divorce, saying, "I can't raise a child with you. The next thing he know, he wake up to find that he has become his wife, and that he was pregnant! He was told, "Pregnancy is not a disease," even as he was asked, "Where's dinner? What about dinner?" Only then did he realize how insensitive he was to his wife's complaints. Will they actually be able to have a baby together? A new kind of maternity life that makes you think about how married couples should be!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: This was the report that when I woke up, I noticed I was my wife and was pregnant

143571.description:
"It took a year. Until I forgot you, until I got up again..."

In the third year of middle school, Seo-Yun runs away from school after receiving an indelible wound from the person he loved. Finally he decides to go to high school and joins the leadership club with great aspirations, but the members of the leadership club who seemed perfect are all strange and unusual people...?

A bittersweet romance full of twists and tears!

(Source: Naver, translated)

143574.description:
The Deity of Cabbage and the Deity of Radish work together in harmony to create the perfect Kimchi. However, the Deity of Cabbage can only moan helplessly under the Deity of Radish?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

143575.description:
Seon-ho, a returning student, and Tae-Yong, a freshman, met at the theater club. Tae-Yong believes thoroughly in Korean superstitions(?), creating unusual situations where he always gets entangled with Seon-Ho. However Tae-Yong, who was trying to find out his compatibility with Seon-Ho, unfortunately ended up writing Seon-Ho’s name in red letters...!!

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

A guy in his early 20s and a girl in her late 20s. The burning desires from this couple can't be stop...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

I'm just worried about you is all!!

Kokone is an unambitious and disillusioned high school girl. Her mom keeps comparing her to her neighbour Murase, a high achiever. So, to release some stress, she teases him about being a virgin, but he just shoots the same question back and offers to relieve her of that particular 'complex'.

Note: Published in Comic KOH #3

143586.description:
A battle against extraterrestrial life that have invaded Earth! A survival drama of fear and trepidation!

(Source: Akita Shoten, translated)

143587.description:
Kamiya Mitsugu, a perverted high school student, tried kissing the three dolls that he found. To his surprise, it ended up transforming the automata into three beautiful girls. But behind the scenes, there are powerful sorcerers who seek to kill him in order to retrieve their missing magic dolls.

Note: Each volume contains an extra chapter.

title.romaji: Ore to Basil no Mahou Ningyou

143589.description: The everyday life of Yuka Maeda a young woman who is "in charge" of her family of 3 (her little sister, her little brother and herself).

143590.description:
I woke up from a coma only to find myself being overrun zombies in a post-apocalyptic world! And that lady is just watching it happen, how cruel is that! Who'd want to stay in this damn place, if it weren't for all the treasures scattered around! I've gotta stay alive, I'm still a virgin! Gold, girls, all mine!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

143594.description: Conan and Kogoro head to the Kingdom of Vespania to save Ran, who was involved in the princess' disappearance. However, Lupin and his friends infiltrate Vespania, going after the royal family's treasure! With the detective's and the thief's paths crossing, how will this end!?

title.native: ルパン三世vs名探偵コナン

143595.description:
Xie SiZhe was once everything for Bai Xi, she could do anything for him. However, his betrayal ruined her whole family…Time-traveling to the past, how can she rewrite her life and take revenge? And is the little fatty who always pays for her silently her true love?

(Source: Mangatoon)

title.native: 嘿! 不要动我的奶酪
title.romaji: Hei! Buyao Dong Wo De Nailuo

143596.description:
Fuyumi and Taoka are a working couple who have just started dating. When they were all worn out after work, Fuyumi saw a show about Sweden on TV. When Fuyumi saw the relaxed Scandinavian lifestyle, she couldn't help but mutter, "I wish I could live there." Yohei, who had been offered a chance to transfer to Sweden the day before, felt like her words were a stroke of fate, and proposed to her right then.

A sudden change of scenery will lead to a new life of "mysig" in a land of happiness.

(Source: Young Animal, translated)

143597.description:
Mio Aragaki has landed a job at a prestigious real estate company in Marunouchi. However, she was assigned to the "Sixth Property Management Department," which dealt with former accident sites! With her cheerful optimism, she will solve the problems with these haunted properties!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 丸の内で就職したら、幽霊物件担当でした。
title.romaji: Marunouchi de Shuushoku Shitara, Yuurei Bukken Tantoudeshita.

143599.description:
You broke 300 million won pottery?!

Oh Jun-Hee, who broke 300 million won worth of pottery while drunk, is a tattoo artist who draws tattoos that he hates..! To pay back 300 million won, you have to work at a tattoo shop!

The story of Oh Jun-Hee's tattoo shop experience.

(Source: Battle Comics, translated)

143600.description:
I'll be the one to save you this time.

While suffering from PTSD, Roman Brennon searches for pianist Yu-Ri Jung's album. He finds it in a small store, but it's sold before Roman can buy it. It is here that he runs into Yu-Ri himself, who has fallen ill and can no longer play the piano. Yu-Ri once saved Roman, but can he return the favor?

(Source: Manta, edited)

143601.description:
Dust piles upon a memory buried deep and once thought to be twisted.

Cowards are afraid of losing each other more than losing their feelings towards each other, they put off their relationship for tomorrow’s love.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

143602.description:
"How can someone not fall in love?"

After being kidnapped, 9-year-old Yo-Han is rescued with the help of Seong-Jin, a highschool student passing by. As a result, their relationship continued as Yo-Han's family sponsored Seong-Jin. As time passed, Yo-Han and Seong-Jin became lovers.

Yohan tries his best to become a great, competent, handsome, friendly, and mature lover who's not an embarassment to Seong-Jin. But sometimes he reaches his limit...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: A Tiny Bit of Cotton Candy

143603.description:
A.O.Z Re-Boot Gundam Inle: Kuro Usagi no Muta Yume is set in U.C. 0091after the end of the First Neo Zeon War. Zeon Remnants had retreated to Mars, forming "ReZeon" under General Alicia Zabi. By absorbing the Titans remnants after the Gryps War, they strengthened their military strength.

This story depicts the Titans comeback that began on Mars. Their dream--what does "the shining star again" mean? Look, with a bird's-eye view, at the memories of their battles spun in history.

Note: The first chapter was pre-published on April 25, 2014 in Dengeki Hobby Magazine.
synonyms: Advance of Zeta Re-Boot: Gundam Inle - Black Rabbit Had a Dream

title.native: A.O.Z Re-Boot ガンダム・インレ-くろうさぎのみた夢
title.romaji: A.O.Z Re-Boot Gundam Inle: Kuro Usagi no Mita Yume

143604.description:
Teaching assistant Han Bom from the art department starts dating her longtime crush and fellow teaching assistant Nam Hae-Seong from a different department. But she gets approached by a promising art student Lee Yun-O.

For some reason, Nam Hae-Seong starts to avoid Bom after they start dating while Lee Yun-O waits for her everyday, tells her he loves her everyday, hugs her tightly and tells her to come to him everyday.

The person I love, the person who loves me, and my spring orchard of flowers, wine and candlelight.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

143605.description:
"So that's why you should tell me quickly. I can't wait any longer..."

One day, after drinking to unconsciousness while comforting a heartbroken friend, someone kissed him on his lips. Seon-Il investigates the case to find out who among them was the criminal(?). But after he figures out who the guilty person was, he starts contemplating deeply about how to reject that person. But why does the suspect keep appearing cute to him...?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

143606.description:
Seong-Ha is loved by men and women of all ages for his mature and kind character. But he has scars that can’t be shown to just anyone... U-Ju is the only friend he can open up to. The day after the final exam, Seong-Hagathers the courage to overcome his wounds and try to change. This is the story of Seong-Ha and U-Ju healing each other.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Note: Part of Kidari Entertainment's "Yeoreumdanpyeonseon: Some in Summer (~키다리이엔티 여름단편선~ 썸인썸머, Kidari Entertainment Summer Short Story Collection: Some in Summer)"

143607.description:
Won-U quits being a child actor because of his parents' greed. But 20 years later, he picks up his acting career again. One day, on his way back home after a shoot, Won-U runs into a fortune teller that gives him a paper that claimed to grant wishes. Won-U half-heartedly writes a wish when the Devil appears before him...

(Source: Copin Comics)

143608.description:
Da-Hyeon and Da-Sol are sisters, and they suddenly look more stunning than I remember. What's going on now?

(Source: Toomics, edited)
synonyms: พี่สาวครับ...เรามารักกันไหม?

143610.description:
At the end of that first meeting on that rainy day... I didn't know what was really waiting for me. And I wonder, if I had known, would I have had this love?

If instead of confessing a desperate love, I would have measured the consequences between good and bad, then could we love each other forever?

(Source: Bookcube, translated)

143611.description:
Paul can leap through time, and uses his ability to overcome life's crises and maintains a smooth life... But after being dumped by his lover, he opens his eyes the next morning to see a handsome man and absolutely no way to leave... He almost managed to escape by turning back time, but that handsome man is the boss of the company...?!

Can Paul really change his fate?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

synonyms: Hardcore Santa and the Spirit's Wail

143616.description: Kenji, a curious boy, helps his older brother in one of his missions. Kenji's brother is secretly a a member of the japanese branch of Mezzon, an organization that protects peace, using the code name Mezzon J. Kenji is then chosen to become a temporary member, with the code name Mezzon Z.

143617.description:
Office worker Mi-Rae just wants a happy life with her boyfriend. But how long can her dream last?

(Source: Toomics, edited)

143618.description:
Jihoon’s always working. He needs to--there’s rent to pay, tuition to take care of, and hospital bills that need to be sorted out. His money problems don’t end when he gets into university, but he soon finds a way to pull himself up by his bootstraps. His part-time job at the girl’s dorm introduces him to a bunch of rich, spoiled, and sexy girls…all of whom want to have their way with him. Why would he say no? It’s his chance to climb up the social ladder, as well as sleeping with the most alluring girls in the school!

(Source: Lezhin X)

I Wanna Be a Daughter Thief
I Want To Become a Daughter Thief
娘さんを頂戴します～俺的ハーレム計画～

143619.description: A sci-fi version of Kobayashi Takiji's proletarian novel Kanikousen, in which we follow the young fisherman Ryusuke, in a fictional future where the sea is evaporating and aquatic creatures have evolved into flying species.

143623.description:
In this world, people are separated into the following genders: alphas, betas, and omegas. Yukihiko Fuyukawa is the successful, strong, and strict manager of a leading sales company. He is good looking, kind, and rich; the perfect package. Everybody swoons in his presence. On the other hand, Natsume, Fuyukawa's subordinate, is weak, sad, and disorganized. He often makes mistakes and has to make up for them by staying late in the office. One such night, Fuyukawa was waiting for his last subordinate, Natsume, to finish his tasks. Suddenly, something utterly dire comes to light: his suppressants have run out! He is in danger! And just as he thought his luck couldn't get any worse, the man he wants least in the entire world, decides to... BOND with him! We repeat: he is in danger!

(Source: Futekiya)

143624.description:
One day, Lee Yeon got into a car accident and had to make a 'physical contract' with a vampire in order to survive... Vampires, werewolves, wizards, and even angels.

A stimulating 19+ action love story about the struggles of those who aim for Lee Yeon's 'body'!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

143625.description:
Jeong-Jin married a woman who has a daughter. He feels happy with his new family, but he can't take his eyes off his step-daughter who dresses too lightly.

"What is wrong with me...? She is still my daughter...!!"

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra story

143626.description:
Shu goes to a bar to find a partner for a one night stand. There, to his surprise, he finds his arch-rival from high school, Reiji.
Having a grudge against him, Shu lures Reiji to a hotel to get a kick out of him. Although he wants Reiji to get down on his knees and beg him for a good time, neither of them wants to be controlled by the other!!
Reiji offers a bet and...!? To prey or be preyed on, the naughty battle begins!

(Source: Brite Publishing)

Note:
- Includes the one-shot "Miwaku no Cinderella Boy (魅惑のシンデレラボーイ)"
- Includes one extra chapter.

143627.description:
Gyeongseong during the Japanese colonial rule in 1928; the reversed fate of two girls.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

143629.description:
Michio has liked his close friend Kyoichi ever since their school days. Having never confessed his feelings, their platonic relationship continues as he turns 21. When Michio awakens one morning, he finds the world around him unfamiliar. He is 29, and the sleeping face next to his is…

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

143632.description:
Jo Jae-Kyeong works part-time at a haunted house. This girl with a scary aura decides to learn how to love in order to realise her dream of becoming an actress. But her partner is the arrogant demon king Cha Min-Hyeok.

143634.description:
Ten years have passed since my brother's dead body was discovered in the bottom of a cliff. Rumour said, he was escaping his engagement and supposed to meet his lover there... But that person never came.

After searching for years, I've finally reunited with him again. "Did you really betray my brother...?" He trembles like a child. But he is still as beautiful as the first time he smiled at me. Kai, the owner of my brother's heart, and the man who had stolen my first love... Who does your heart belong to?

"Tempest of Cage" is your ideal Taisho-era BL that involves tragedy, family drama, and a love triangle. Follow Yoshihisa and Kai on the journey to make peace with their past...

Cheong-Ho is a national swim team member who has been struggling with poor records. As an alpha, his physical condition could be improved greatly through sex with an omega, but he has a fear of omega pheromones. His hopes of being a top swimmer seem to be sinking, but that all changes when he meets Yi-Rim, an omega whose pheromones don’t give off any scent. Yi-Rim is only too happy to help Cheong-Ho out, and thus the two of them start a purely physical relationship. It’s almost like they’re a match made in heaven. The first half deals with the personal history of Marquis Memphis as a nobleman and general. The latter half depicts the political movement trying the social reform with the revolutionary party in Bothnia.

Indeed, a rumour’s been circulating among the local girls that a vampire has come to their backwater, of all places. Koyomi Araragi, who prefers to avoid having friends because they’d lower his “intensity as a human,” is naturally sceptical. Yet it is to him that the bloodsucking demon, a concept “dated twice over,” beckons on the first day of spring break as he makes his way home with a fresh loot of morally compromising periodicals.

Unlike ne’er-do-well former vampire Araragi, his two younger sisters Karen and Tsukihi, who attend a private junior high, are little balls of energy and charisma that their peers look up to. That the “ka” in Karen and “hi” in Tsukihi are both written with the character for “fire” isn’t the only reason they’ve come to be known as the Fire Sisters. Karen is the brawn and Tsukihi the brains of a vigilantism that the pair sees not merely as defending justice but as justice itself. They can’t encounter a harmful fad without trying to hunt down a specific source that had a motive for spreading it. 143720.description:
How far does one go to help a lost child? In the case of returning narrator Araragi, the answer is too far, across the veil of time. Dutifully (if unknowingly) following up on Hachikuji’s cheeky foreshadowing, he concerns himself with his young lady friend and her fate in this instalment of the cult-hit series, heroically unable, once again, to find his own way home.

Thus the tale is also, or more so, about the journey itself, the dark honeymoon of a trip he takes into the past with the dweller in his shadow, Shinobu. Even among a cast that routinely disrespects chronology with their meta-commentary, she takes the cake, or the doughnut, by rewinding the clock for a perverse road movie, one that by and large goes nowhere, spatially.

It’s Kabuki not as in the theatre, but with the character for “tilt”—as in a slanted attitude toward the world, the posture of a bohemian. Or, perhaps, of a legendary vampire who once sought death, and of a high school senior who once tuned out life doing their dandy best to attend to an embarrassing wealth of aberrations in a provincial town.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

143721.description:
Our sorry hero, his reformed girlfriend, and the amnesiac class president have all graduated from their high school out in the boondocks, and self-described Sapphist and ex-basketball ace Kanbaru, retired by reason of an “injury,” is starting her senior year and the narrator of this volume—her voice far more introspective than the smutty jock’s we thought we knew.

Bereft of the company of her beloved mentors, the only other person around her with any working knowledge of aberrations the junior Ougi Oshino, apparently a relative of the Hawaiian-shirted folklorist, she feels a bit alone and blue, and sick with dread that the devil residing in her left arm courtesy of the Monkey’s Paw might act up again while she sleeps.

Investigating a rumour that she fears might lead back to her, the former star ends up peering into an abyss of negativity called Rouka. Trapped in a pit the like of which could only be escaped by the one girl who was able to pull off slam-dunks in her basketball nationals, can the penitent Kanbaru, however, still be aggressive?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

143722.description:
A certain middle school girl has a fondness for hats, which serve as a line of defence against eye contact along with the overlong bangs she’s worn ever since she was little. Speaking in fits and starts when she doesn’t fall completely silent, her go-to line is “I’m sorry,” and she’s given to referring to herself in third person. 143723.description:
Sometimes it snows in April…

Have you ever felt that there was something missing inside of you? Have you ever been envious of what other people have? Have you ever wished for someone that could make you whole? You need not worry any longer. Your time is near. A new possibility is dawning–a time that will end all suffering.

From the mind of Kohei Kadono comes the thrilling second novel in the mind-bending Boogiepop series–Boogiepop Returns: VS Imaginator Part 1. Witness the first appearances of the mysterious Towa Organization–a major player in the Boogiepop Phantom anime series–as Boogiepop finds himself hunted by the synthetic human known only as “Spooky E”. All the while, a deadly entity is out to remake humanity in its image, one mind at a time. Can you escape from the clutches of the Imaginator…?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

143724.description:
It, like the dark that makes up most of the cosmos, is not an aberration. Nonbeing can swallow you whole, yet if anything, it’s the anti-aberration. Darkness, in fact, is the Law, an executioner from whom a mark can try to run and hide, but only for so long. When it comes calling, the fortunate just might have the time to say goodbye. And the Darkness is—here now. Before ever visiting Japan to find a place to die, four centuries, indeed, before her failed suicide attempt, the legendary vampire KissShot literally stepped foot on the land of the rising sun with an epic jump that ended a lonely sojourn in Antarctica. It was back in those days that the proud noble created her first thrall. It was then, too, that she first met the Darkness.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

143725.description:
After attending the funeral of his high school classmate Qin Xiaoshang, Xu Zhou returns back to the time when he was in high school due to an accident. At this time his family is not falling apart, and his friends are still by his side. As for Qin Xiaoshang, who will meet his tragic fate in a few years, he is still that teen who secretly draws Xu Zhou in a corner... Everything is repeating once again, and Xu Zhou feels that whether it is his high school grades or his future, he could still be rescued.

143726.description:
Circling back to a middle school girl’s apotheosis, if we can call it that, in OTORIMONOGATARI, and the mortal threat it poses to the hero and his girl, this “Season Two” finale is narrated, for the first time in the series, by a grown-up—but if the word conjures a sense of reliability, of stability and certainty to you, dear reader, then the lesson to take home from this is to trust no one.

Because the teller of the tale, who has been summoned by the heroine to defuse the situation, despite having been her nemesis since the very outset of the series, is—in the absence of the equally shady adult, Oshino, who at least was an expert—none other than his college frenemy, the fake ghostbuster who doesn’t believe in ghosts, the shameless swindler Deishu Kaiki.

And it is indeed a con that he agrees to perpetrate, uncharacteristically pro bono, on a wrathful god—a mythic undertaking if true, which it may be, when a liar among liars holds that his story, like any other, is all a lie. But maybe not, when a man who claims to be wise in the ways of the world sounds just as self-conscious as his adolescent counterparts or a Russian anti-hero.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Six boys and girls with psychic powers. A tentative alliance from which friendships emerge. But when Boogiepop and a mysterious little girl start showing up in their visions of the future, the six friends find themselves caught up in a chain of events that could put the entire world at risk. With both their lives and their newfound bonds on the line, can they protect each other–and the secrets they’re still keeping?

Calendar Tale, narrated by our titular hero, sends us to various earlier points in the story where certain events had yet to occur—when, for instance, the shady “expert” Oshino was still in town, and the ex-legendary vampire Shinobu hadn’t tired of sulking in a corner. After revisiting with a “case files” feel of the series’ origins, we will start to catch up to the present moment until we are violently spliced back into the overarching plot.

Weaving in a motif of ways, paths, roads, and streets—walks of life—the nostalgic vignettes hark back to the “case files” feel of the series-launching Monster Tale, but with a twist. Not all oddities are supernatural: stones and flowers; sand and water; the wind and the tree can just be plain weird without being aberrations. The vignettes for the months of October to March deal with six ladies who are either not quite human or older than titular narrator Koyomi Araragi, bless his bantering soul.

In this instalment, say hello from the future to class president among class presidents Hanekawa, acid-tongued girlfriend Senjogahara, cheeky lost child Hachikuji, smutty athlete Kanbaru, pathologically shy Sengoku, and justice-loving martial artist Karen, young ladies who love to make our young man sweat. See how he handles—or is handled by—aberration of a little sister Tsukihi, enigma of a freshman or -woman Ougi, shadow of a legendary vampire Shinobu, corpse of a tween girl Ononoki, psychopath of a monster expert Kagenui, and know-it-all of a Machiavellian fixer Izuko Gaen.

(Source: Kodansha USA, edited)

Note: The English release was split across two volumes, instead of the original singular volume.

143744.description:
Lee Yoo, an ordinary aspiring actor, abandons his stable civil service job to chase his dreams. After enduring a series of crushing failures, he finds himself at the brink of giving up. Just then, a popular vlogger offers him a lucrative acting gig with a catch: Yoo must pretend to be his boyfriend. What begins as a simple business arrangement soon blurs the lines between fantasy and reality, leaving both men questioning what is genuine as their on-screen romance starts to feel all too real.
