143747.description:
Volume 1:
Before we witness the series’ climactic showdown in the third volume of the End Tale—each part of which forms its own cohesive whole—narrator Araragi wrestles with a crucial bit of history that had turned him into the loner we met at the very beginning, who opined that friendships only lowered his intensity as a human.
What initiates his pilgrim’s progress of a reckoning is his first encounter, at school, with the mysterious freshman Ogi Oshino, self-described niece of the equally enigmatic aberration expert Mèmè, and the book’s opening chapter is a harrowing standalone novella of a who-dunit involving a locked room of sorts.
Our increasingly well-adjusted hero kept on beingdecent at one thing even when he was just hanging on, but this forte, an unlikely aptitude for math, of all things, becomes the focus of a cheating scandal and a web of recollections that forces him to come to terms with, what do you know, his capacity to connect to people.

Volume 2:
When an old flame who gave up on life and chose to go up in flames—because he wanted to leave you but couldn’t—comes crawling back after four hundred years, you might not appreciate it, especially if you’re in a new relationship. But nothing’s ever simple between people, and that’s even truer between monsters.
For the first time in months, our heroic loser Araragi is human, parted by previous events from the ex-legendary vampire bound to his shadow. Before he, the second-ever thrall of the former Kissshot, can resume his partnership with the donut-loving waif that she’s turned into, she must make a choice—about that first-ever.
Before the End Tale can end, some loose ends must be tied, and in this volume, the fixer Gaen calls in her favor, requesting an introduction to her niece; the errand of the amulet that Araragi ran with Kanbaru comes into crisp focus; and the time-traveling and -spanning Dandy and Demon Tales see their devastating resolution.

Volume 3:
No good deed goes unpunished, they say, and so does friendship and lowering your intensity as a human, they don’t say—alas, for all his literally painful hustle and inveterate need to save others, our brave fool of a hero ends up in hell, a conception of the inferno in its full Buddhist glory, and muses (lol) if there’s a return ticket.
Told in three chapters, the final part of End Tale concludes the story proper and resolves the series’ panoply of ongoing mysteries: the dues of a do-gooder for relying on a power not his own, the identity of a shady transfer student, the outcome of a class president’s questing abroad, and even the true name of a park.
Araragi, indeed, is the one who knows, but along the way he meets old faces, really every last one of them, who aid him on his journey for understanding, and perhaps for salvation, and you for one might not be surprised if he had another rendezvous with an erstwhile “cloistered princess” before it—guess what it is—sees an end.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

143749.description:
Just when we thought the darkness menacing the town had been identified, named, and tamed, clear and unclear mysteries of seasons past looming or surfacing, then resolving, not without tears, not without bittersweetness, of course, but satisfyingly, in a tripartite finale, all loose ends tied up into, or at least with, a bow…
The End Tale continues—if only for one last time, in a bonus stage for the ages, as our softie of a protagonist who wished for all parties involved, including himself, maturely enough, to end up happy, sees his reflected image freeze in a mirror and regretfully, regrettably, reaches for it to find himself through the looking glass.
In an alternate reality where bits of the world have been flipped around, the hero comes face to face with the hidden side(s) of familiar faces, along with author NISIOISIN, whose bravura attempt to reimagine character possibilities concludes, with signature flair, the MONOGATARI series proper—thank you for reading.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

"Oh, you hired an employee.”
“No, just… just a temporary part-timer.”

Do-Kyeong is the owner of a small neighborhood cafe. One day, he gives a free cake to a customer who comes to the cafe. Not long after that, the customer, U-Yeong, quits a prestigious company and comes to work at the cafe as a part-timer...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

143801.description:
Kazunari Yanagi, 28, is a teacher who loves the underground boy band, Star Compass.No matter how underpaid he may be and no matter how much overtime he has to put in, he feels energized, just by seeing the boys smile!! Kazunari's life is great because Rikkun, his favorite, is aware of him as a regular fan of the group. One day, Kazunari is transferred to a different school. He works hard to adjust while wondering what the deal is with a student named Riku Agarizaki, who has never once been in class. Then it's soon time for midterm exams. Told that Riku has come to class, Kazunari is glad that he will finally meet the mysterious student... and can hardly believe his eyes.

A story about forbidden love... between a pop star-slash-student and his number one fan-slash-teacher!!!

(Source: Renta!)

"I want to be kind only to Tomoya-kun."

It's fun because he overreacts. I try to keep my distance and concentrate on my work, but on the other hand I can't resist him. One night while we were working overtime together, I kissed him in a drunken moment!?

In contrast to her past life in Korea, the storybook world Rayne Haatz inhabits is full of wonders—think dreamy powers, nobles inspired by card suits, and anthromorphs. There’s just one issue… her destiny in this world is to die! Luckily, it seems that someone wants her alive. In her fourth life, Rayne vows to stop her scheming family from giving Emperor Jaynen the dark nightmares that drive him mad and lead to her death. But after three deaths, has Rayne learned enough to change her fate? Or will her feelings for Jaynen complicate her plans?

They said Aia was destined to be a model, and Jun was bullied for her freckles. Together, they will take back the power to define themselves in an inspirational fashion manga that asks cutting questions about what it really means to be beautiful—and what it takes to overcome an arbitrary system that seems to respect talent over hard work.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

143818.description:
After ten years of pretending to be the count’s hated daughter, Karuna is ready to escape. However, her plan goes sideways when she gets attacked. In order to save herself, she takes a potion that promises to turn back time. Instead, it transforms Karuna into a child. Things get even weirder when she witnesses a giant wolf transform into Duke Vykeld, and now she must hide out in his isolated manor. After terrorizing nobles for ten years, can Karuna handle being a child again?

(Source: Tapas)

143819.description:
Chitose can't take his eyes off the guy from the class next door, dozing off in class by the window. Each time Chitose leans out the window to sneak a look at him, he's always there, dozing off as expected. His name: Seno. He's a year older, but according to rumors, he was absent for a year because he was involved in a fight. Chitose is a friendly and sweet-hearted high-schooler and Seno is a mysterious guy. The two polar opposites gradually open their hearts to each other... A chaotic and heartwarming school-love between a cheery puppy and a questionable grade repeater.

Note: Chapter counts include extra chapters.

143820.description:
College student and model, Sari, is really an Omega, but he hates it so much he's decided to live as a Beta. One day, his manager (and older sister) asks him to scout Taiga, another Beta at the same school for a pair modeling session.
The two hit it off from their first meeting and celebrate the end of the shoot. Sari feels comfortable with Taiga, but under some intoxicating force, he goes into heat from Taiga's smell. Although he thought Taiga was a Beta, it turns out that, just like Sari, he's also been hiding his real sex and is actually an Alpha...!?

143821.description:
Iharu is a university student looking for ways to kill time over spring break. In passing, he meets an attractive young man named Shin who invites him on a trip to the hot springs. He accepts Shin's offer and finds himself at an elegant inn with outdoor baths and hidden springs--not to mention luxurious meals and amazing sake... Lost in his happiness, he decides to enter the hot springs with Shin. But when he looks at the young man undressing, he can't believe his eyes... "Even his dick is gorgeous! His butt is so shapely!" Even after Iharu turns in for the night, he can't stop thinking about Shin's amazing body... and growing increasingly horny.

(Source: Manga.Club)

In order to support them, the protagonist, Hashiba Yuutarou, agreed to work part-time at the shop for a crappy salary, but he has a secondary goal, which is approaching his love interest, Suzuhara Akane. Will their love blossom?

143830.description:
An unlucky girl tangled with curses is secretly in love with the prom king. When the "lord angel" she waited for ages finally came to her, he took her first kiss and is interested in floating in the air and tearing her sheets! Is it "gene mutation"?

(Source: Mangatoon)

143831.description:
Aoki and Tengoku starts dating and slowly deepens their relationship. But one day, when Aoki is talking with his friend on speakerphone while cooking, he brings up what Aoki said some time ago that he had no plans to marry his current partner. Tengoku hears but says nothing about it. When Tengoku leaves after the dinner, Aoki walks together to the station with a slight feeling of uneasiness. They kiss on the way, on the dark, lonely street at night. When Aoki notices someone passing by see them kissing, he almost unintentionally says “...This sucks”. Now Tengoku suddenly changes his tune and walks away, leaving Aoki alone and perplexed. Why does Tengoku leave like that? Their good relationship now seems to be in crisis...

(Source: Takeshobo)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

She had thought the days together had ended..., but her body couldn't forget the pleasure, and she masturbated despite the guilt she felt...

143837.description: In post-apocalyptic Japan, a nameless mahjong player ascends a massive tower, facing formidable opponents in life or death gambles.

143838.description:
Now that he’s a cool college student, our anti-hero Iichan thinks his crime-solving days are behind him. Cynical, sarcastic and minimally engaged in his studies, Iichan is much more interested in his own feelings of disaffection and isolation. But despite his resolve to remain aloof, he’s pulled into the narrative when he encounters and bonds with a serial killer named Hitoshi Zerozaki – a homicidal maniac with the soul of an artist whose talent is on display at the grisly scenes of his crimes.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

An earnestly honest guy who doesn’t even grant pipe dreams to himself, physiologically incapable of letting a single contradiction go, in other words me, got dragged this June to a renowned academy for rich girls, no questions allowed, by the world’s strongest contractor. No matter how you put it, no matter how you spin it, there was probably no point to it. Because the case that arose there was, in and of itself, a bit of nonsense.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

Tomo, Neon, Ii, Kyouichirou, Shito, Misachi, Kokoromi, Kasugai, Gaisuke, Jun, Kouta, Houko, Nanami Dead Blue (Tomo Kunagisa) ——is desperate!

"You actually hate Tomo Kunagisa, don't you?"
The genius engineer and former member of Tomo Kunagisa's Team, Gaisuke Utsurigi, is being held captive at a mysterious research facility—Kyouichirou Shadou (Mad Demon)'s Research Institute. Accompanied by her friend Ii—aka the Nonsense User, Iichan—are on their way to rescue Utsurigi, but are met with a horrifying "scene" that unfolds before their eyes. However, this "end" is only a taste of the "beginning" to come——!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

サイコロジカル（下）　曳かれ者の小唄

143841.description:
The No. 1 Killing Name, "Niounomiya", has finally arrived!

".....Specifically, what are you researching, Assistant Professor Kigamine?"
"——Researching not dying."
Invited to monitor the bizarre research on Kuchiha Madoka—a girl who lives eternal—Ii, the Nonsense User, visits the ruins of a clinic in northern Kyoto with antique apartment dwellers Ichihime Yukariki and Kasuga Kasugai.
However, what awaits them there is a terrible "fate" itself!
The Niounomiya siblings, the number one killers in the world, make their debut in this exciting new coming-of-age story.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

143842.description:
It may be true that where there is a beginning, there is an end, but it is too shortsighted to think that because there is an end, there must have been a beginning. In fact, the opposite is true. Most events have already ended even before they began, and they are closed even if they are not opened. I, a sincere and honest person who dares not speak truth as truth, dares not speak fact as fact, and knows the virtue of silence better than anyone else, will ascend a certain staircase in September. The Thirteenth Staircase. It was Kino-Raichi, Noise, Emoto Sonoki, Mio-tsukushi Takami, and Mio-tsukushi Misora. However, what awaits me at the top of the stairs is so ridiculous and so nostalgic… in this sixth installment of the "Zaregoto" series!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)
synonyms: Uprooted Radical (Part One): The Thirteen Stairs
Uprooted Radical (Part Two): Overkill Red vs. The Orange Seed
Uprooted Radical (Part Three): The Blue Savant and the Nonsense User

143843.description:
Xiong Jiujiu works as a manhua artist, yet lost his job because his boss ran away taking all the money with him. The peaceful life which he had was nowhere to be seen. At the same time, Yu Xincheng was also troubled about his ability to settle in this vast city, until he saw the "for rent" notice posted by Xiong Jiujiu. Naturally, the two became roommates, and slowly, they found themselves hiding their own secrets...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

143845.description: Living in a wealthy family, Gaoyin is a real upstart. He wears a special "A" collar at school and is a thorn in the side of the other male students. One day, his family unexpectedly goes bankrupt, his elder sister and father disappear without a trace, and his mother is arrested by the Bureau of Investigation. He had been living like an idiot while he was wealthy and now with nothing left, he is forced to work. Even his longtime girlfriend Alice starts looking to for a new boyfriend... (Source: Tongli, translated)

143847.description:
The story, centered around Ah Men's daily life, always has unexpected endings - sometimes healing, sometimes funny, sometimes passionate, sometimes touching. The joys and sorrows of life are all worth savoring. "What you encounter is what you possess." Let the adorable raccoon take you through the seasons, experiencing the little moments of happiness in the world.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

143848.description: Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the web novel of the same name.

143849.description:
Qin You is a handsome livestreamer who one day picks up a cute little kitten on the street. However, he didn't know that he actually picked up a demon than can turn into a human! Qin You has fragmented memories of his past, and somehow the little kitten he picked up is involved.

(Source: INKR)

143853.description:
Part-time cafe worker Kasumi is handsome and sociable, but has a hangup around being begged. Unable to finish with his partners, he couldn't help but wonder if he was the problem. It's around this time that Kasumi starts to take a liking for one of his regulars, Seiichiro.

It's just, ever since "Seiichi" showed up to the cafe with his friend, he's been acting weird... Unable to control himself, Kasumi ends up giving Seiichi a kiss, and is thrown off by his reaction!

A love story about two men, each with their own traumatic past.

(Source: Brite Publishing)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: Request and a Kiss arent needed

title.english: Don't Beg Me, Don't Kiss Me
title.native: おねだりもキスも欲しくない

143854.description:
The Leader of the Imperial Guard, Li Sheng, doesn't believe that "getting back together is torturous". So long as he does a good enough job, even an iceberg will into melt a puddle of water! It's a good thing that Martial Arts Master Lang is so handsome! This time, Li Sheng isn't running away! He's putting down roots and staying put! o(////▽////)o

[Ruthless Emotional Military Genius Dom x Idiotic Masochist Imperial Guard Sub]

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

143855.description: Daiya, who's interested in the artist Eisaku—a regular at the bar he works at— and spends his days researching about his past to the type of underwear he wears, ends up going to Eisaku's house!? Now that Eisaku is in a slump, Daiya uses it as an opportunity to propose that they have sex!?

143856.description:
My name is Hyosin Lee, and I just want to get one thing straight: I am not a thief! I ran away from home to escape my stifling household but ended up lost in the mountains where I found a pile of clothes. How was I supposed to know that they belonged to the very handsome half-fairy, San Baek? He has (reluctantly) let me stay with him because I was badly injured. He doesn’t talk much, but he’s kind and I like being with him… However, I know it won’t be long until my family finds me and when that happens… I’ll never be able to see San again!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 12 side story chapters

title.english: The Boy Who Stole From the Fairy Lake

143857.description:
A popular actor transmigrated into a movie script and becomes a character that is supposed to die early! He can only return to reality if a natural anomaly occurs on the day of the peace negotiations between 2 countries. In order to live until "The End", and as a cinematic "king", he activates his survival mode...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: The title comes from a line in the poem 《走马川行奉送封大夫出师西征》by 唐岑参, talking about a general leading an expedition of soldiers. The original meaning of the line is that the general keeps his armor on even at night due to the harsh and dangerous nature of the expedition, but the double entendre here is that the general doesn't take off his clothes (refuses advances) at night.

title.romaji: Jiangjun Jin Jia Ye Bu Tuo

143858.description:
Xiang Qi, who was previously a problematic student in Yu Cai High School, surprisingly transmigrated into a cultivation world called "Hong Meng" when he was attending a Year 3 Class 2 classmate's meeting. He thought he was the male protagonist, yet his life sucked. To survive, he had no choice but to take the path of cultivation, and then noticed a weird sect called "Yu Cai Immortal Sect". Someone called Xi Hongjun, who has the same name as his enemy, and is also the smartest student in high school, became his master. Not only are their names are the same, but they also look very alike and have the same b*tchy personality! And that Sect Leader who looks just like his monitor... Everything just seems more and more strange!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Immortal Clan of Bringing Up Talents

143859.description:
Emilia is reborn in a romance game as the jealous friend of Ophelia Windrose. Knowing that Ophelia will die young, Emilia chooses to love her, and the two grow as close as sisters. After her friend's death, Emilia departs to live a quiet life. The three male love interests are supposed to use the loss to connect to Ophelia's replacement. But instead of pursuing her, they all seem more interested in Emilia! Can Emilia navigate their newfound desire, or will she always be in Ophelia's shadow?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: จุดจบแสนเศร้าของเกมโอโตเมะ

143860.description:
Treacheries, lies and humiliation, no one knows what she’s been through. She thought she was in her worst nightmare, but it was just a beginning. Nightmares came one after another and the world seemed so unreal… Will fate break her heart again?

(Source: Mangatoon)

143862.description:
Chloe Garnache is an alluring trap for the emperor. After living a life full of abuse at the hands of her family, Chloe is finally freed from her torture by the grand duke, Kairos Ludwig. However, her days of getting taken advantage of are far from over. The only reason Kairos took her in is because of her beauty, which he plans to use in order to lure and kill the emperor. Chloe willingly follows Kairos’ orders, having fallen for his kind and gentle gestures.

Unfortunately, her feelings are never returned, and she is met with a pitiful death once her task is fulfilled. But just when things seem to be over, Chloe awakens to find herself back before her life came spiraling down. And this time, she won’t be swayed by the sweet words of the devilish grand duke…

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: 私が愛した人は優しい悪魔でした
I'll Twist The Neck of a Sweet Dog

title.english: I Shall Kill That Sweet Devil

143864.description:
Yu Xiang transmigrates into a book and becomes the Marquis's unfavored sister, plagued by a disability and branded an ill-omen. Moreover, she is an imposter, left with no choice but to rely on her elder brother for protection, planning to step aside quietly once his biological sister comes home. However, when his real sister finally returns years later, the Marquis forbids her from leaving…

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Hu Ru Yi Ye Bing Jiao Lai

143865.description:
Guan Qingyan is just a naive girl, so naive that she even signs a marriage document and gets sent into a large mansion. Her husband, President Mingjue, seems to be a very wolfish man in their first encounter, but turns out to be a loving husband. Still, Ming Jue's childhood sweetheart, Miss Feng, and his nagging mother keep creating trouble to Qingyan, but the childlike girl doesn't care about anything...

(Source: Mangatoon)
synonyms: 我还小：狼性老公太凶猛

title.english: Naive Girl and Her Wolfish Husband

143867.description:
In 18th-century Paris, "A woman's fortune is made by marrying a good man."
But Sophie, the daughter of a fabric store owner, spends her days thinking about mathematics instead, even in her sleep.
At first, her family didn't understand her dream, but her "obsession" was infectious, and before she knew it, everyone was supporting her pursuit!

(Source: good! Afternoon, translated)

143868.description:
Soon after losing her parents in a tragic car accident, Seol-Young meets her end, her death cleverly faked as a suicide by the murderer. She draws her last breath - cursing the Hong family for everything they'd done to make her life miserable - and wakes up in an entirely different world, with servants tending to her and addressing her as "My Lady." Now in her new body, Seol-Young must find a way to not only fend for herself in this hostile new world, but also cast her long-awaited revenge!

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Flowers Are Flowers, Leaves Are Leaves
Blüte zu Blüte, Blatt zu Blatt

143869.description:
In this world, there are humans without beast ears, and humans with beast ears called Bestia. After the ordeal with Sougo's father, Akira and Sougo are spending one happy day at a time with their son, Shouta. A relaxing vacation in Hawaii brings them closer than ever, and it seems Shouta will soon be a big brother! On another note, Sougo's father, Soushi, is reunited with his first love: Yuu Ohara, one of Shouta's daycare teachers. Memories between the two resurface, and they are still drawn to each other, just like the day they first met. Can the two of them finally have their happily ever after?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ケダモノアラシ－Hold me baby!－

143870.description:
In this world, there are humans without beast ears and humans with beast ears called Bestia. Sougo and Akira, a happily married Bestia couple, live blissfully with their ever-growing family. Things stir up a bit when Sougo's half-brother, Kazuhisa, makes his appearance and offers Akira to produce an offspring with him, much to Sougo's annoyance. What will Akira do? In order to do some digging and to find some evidence of their connection, Jae-Hwan goes to the Taeryong rooftop party and unintentionally becomes involved with Liu Yuan, the mafia boss. Will Jae-Hwan be able to get the scoop from this heartless mobster? What is the secret connection between these two Hong Kong giants?

(Source: Lezhin US)

But when she crushes the ring and falls asleep after failing to end her own life, she dreams of five demigods, who greet her in person a week later after she awakes! Their one request to her is this: live on so that they may live forever. In return, they promise to make her life worth living, but can they uphold that promise?

In her final moments, she recalls her previous life, when she was just a normal Japanese high school girl, but that doesn't help the fact that she's being eaten alive by a massive plant monster.

And yet, by a stroke of luck, she doesn't die for good, but instead reincarnates as said plant monster. With the upper half of a human and the lower half of a plant, she must now spend her life as an Alraune.

If he could change the future, Shinichirou would, without a doubt, save her after she died following severe bullying. With his adult mentality and corporate powers, he is going to enact his revenge by bringing the best out of his second youth with her!

Experienced playboy Kawai discovers a new side of himself when he meets the sweet and naive Hachiya! Kawai appears to be a competent and refined apparel sales rep who is popular with his colleagues. However, the truth is that he's a domineering playboy. Honoka Aoi, a determined young woman, finds herself facing a daunting challenge: helping her family pay off their debts. With few options available, she takes a bold step into the world of hostessing, hoping to earn enough money to help her parents. But her lack of experience leads to frequent mistakes and she struggles to attract clients. Desperate to succeed, she decides to seek guidance from an unlikely source—the nearby Host Club. To her surprise, Honoka discovers that the No. 1 host at the club is none other than her teacher! Will her teacher give her special lessons and teach her the elusive "nightly techniques" essential for success in the world of hostessing?

He even has a plan for her: marry one of the current occupants! But Jojo’s never been in a relationship and needs all the help she can get. So he had to put up with Lin Mu’s flippant words and teasing, and even had to take it upon himself to butter up to him and… feed this tiger with his body. Will he be eaten by the tiger, or will he be able to tame the tiger and turn him into his big kitty?
